tokens.name: hunter-deep
tokens.usage: Primary anchor: signage fields, headers, hero surfaces, the default dark ground. Court Cream text on it is 11.99:1.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Secondary panels, directional signage, tone-on-tone and the rate panel on Hunter Deep. Court Cream text on it is 7.31:1; Amber Gold on it is 3.42:1, so gold text on Forest only at 24px+ (or bold 19px+).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Botanical accent (the laurel), 'open' status. Sparing. Never text on cream (3.09:1): dots, leaves and icons only.

tokens.name: court-cream
tokens.usage: Light surfaces and all text on green. The brand's light default: never replace it with white.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Body text on cream (14.18:1) and Cream 100 (15.91:1). Never pure black.

tokens.name: amber-gold
tokens.usage: Trim, court numbers, dividers, arrows, dots and one accent button: under 10% of any layout. Text on Hunter Deep 5.61:1. Fails as text on cream (2.14:1). Never a dominant background, never on sage.

tokens.name: hunter-deep-900
tokens.usage: UI states: pressed Hunter Deep, the base of the photo and dialog scrims.

tokens.name: forest-500
tokens.usage: UI states: Forest hover. Court Cream text on it is 5.58:1.

tokens.name: sage-200
tokens.usage: UI states: open-status tint on dark.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: UI states: open-status tint on cream.

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Card fill on the cream ground (Surface Card); input fill.

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Court Cream in the cream scale.

tokens.name: cream-300
tokens.usage: UI states: pressed cream, switch track off, a quiet divider fill.

tokens.name: cream-400
tokens.usage: UI states: disabled fills on cream. Too light for borders that must be seen (1.4:1).

tokens.name: amber-600
tokens.usage: Link hover on cream; the amber total line in cream price cards ('YOU PAY ฿4,500'). 3.1:1 on cream, 3.48:1 on Cream 100: large text (24px+ / bold 19px+) only.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Amber Gold in the amber scale.

tokens.name: amber-300
tokens.usage: Hover for the solid Amber Gold button; Hunter Deep text on it is 8.11:1.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Dark ground: signage, headers, social posts, rate cards.

tokens.name: surface-light
tokens.usage: Light ground: pages, brochures, forms.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards on the light ground, and the cream price cards on Hunter Deep.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim, with a 3px backdrop blur. One of only two places transparency is allowed.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on Surface Light and Surface Card.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings and prices on Surface Light and Surface Card (11.99:1 on cream).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Surface Light (5.65:1) and Surface Card (6.34:1); also the border of form controls on cream.

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: All text on Hunter Deep (11.99:1) and Forest (7.31:1).

tokens.name: text-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Hunter Deep (6.38:1). On Forest it is 4.34:1, just under 4.5:1: keep it to 19px+ there or use Text On Dark.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, dates and small labels on Hunter Deep (5.61:1). Not for text on cream or small text on Forest.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links on Surface Light (7.31:1).

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover on cream (3.1:1): a transient state, always keep the underline so the link still reads.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on cream: cards, table rules, the perk rules in price cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-hairline-dark
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on Hunter Deep and Forest: nav separators, wayfinder rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-card-dark
tokens.usage: The hairline on dark cards (which drop the shadow).

tokens.name: border-gold
tokens.usage: The signature inset gold trim, 10px inside plaques, posts and premium panels; also the frame around the Forest rate panel. One per view.

tokens.name: status-open
tokens.usage: Open / available: a dot plus the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-booked
tokens.usage: Booked: a dot plus the word.

tokens.name: status-closed
tokens.usage: Closed: warm brick, a dot plus the word. Court Cream text on it is 5.53:1; as a dot on Hunter Deep it is only 2.17:1, so pair it with the word. Generic red only where legally required.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 1px focus border on every control, plus the Focus Halo. Kept exactly as specified: 5.61:1 on Hunter Deep but only 2.14:1 on cream, under the 3:1 a focus ring needs there (see the README).

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: The 3px ring outside the focus border.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark set in type, uppercase. Scales fluidly with fs-wordmark: clamp(48px,7vw,112px). Force lining figures.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Poster and hero headlines, uppercase. Short headlines of one to three words (COURT RATES, BUNDLE RATES) take ls-wordmark 0.16em.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Section heroes and signage headlines, uppercase.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on rate cards and posters: baht sign first, lining figures always (font-feature-settings: "lnum" 1). Unit follows in body-lg on Text On Dark Muted or Text Muted.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Two premium indoor courts in Lam Lukka, Pathum Thani.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, poster subcopy, the '/ hour' unit beside a price.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Court rental is charged per court, per hour.
styles.usage: Editorial body, rules, brochure paragraphs; 64ch measure.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Soft opening rates for our first players.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows and dates above headlines, uppercase; Text Accent on dark.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav, form labels, wayfinding, schedules, uppercase.

styles.name: thai-display
styles.sample: แพ็กเกจเหมาชั่วโมง
styles.usage: Thai headlines at any display size: Kanit 200, one weight lighter and one leading step looser than Latin. Never uppercase, never tracked.

styles.name: thai-heading
styles.sample: ราคาการจองสนาม

styles.name: thai-body
styles.sample: ค่าเช่าสนามคิดเป็นรายสนาม ต่อชั่วโมง
styles.usage: Thai body copy. The 1.85 leading is required: at 1.6 vowel marks collide with the next line's tone marks.

styles.name: thai-label
styles.usage: Thai labels, buttons and wayfinding: emphasis by weight and colour, never letter-spacing.
